name: MetaCapabilities deny widening and separate structural powers

input.fixture_ref: fixture: {setup: "Class A inherits and composes denies for method_set, method_body, property_set, property_body, class_state_set, and class_state_write", actions: ["try source meta deny that widens a denied capability", "try reflection/native/host helper mutations for each separated capability", "try protected built-in superclass mutation through each meta path"]}

applicability.reason: Requires the complete ReflectionPolicy/Host/native meta-operation surfaces and capability audit hooks, not just ordinary source dispatch.

expect.status: Every path lowers to the same operation-level MetaCapabilities; inherited or composed denies are immutable for the revision; denied operations fail atomically; method_set is checked separately from method_body, property_set from property_body, and class_state_set from class_state_write.
